scope: Authenticated admin SIEM router persists configuration and preserves the masked credential on edit; full proxy ASGI lifespan generates detections; actual HTTP HEC export; authenticated SPL search retrieves full ECS events by the response X-Request-ID.
before_fix: Generic ECS array rejected by live HEC with HTTP 400, code 5 (No data). Wrapped ECS accepted with HTTP 200, code 0.
fixes: Serialize batches as concatenated HEC envelopes containing the entire ECS document.
Use the Splunk Authorization scheme for splunk and splunk_es platform identifiers.
Require a valid integer HEC success code, not HTTP success alone.
Preserve event timestamp and inherit index/sourcetype from operator HEC token configuration.
not_validated: Splunk Enterprise Security licensed application and CIM mapping
Full deployed admin middleware and HTTP server
Browser workflow (login page responds but not automated)
HEC indexer acknowledgements (search verified indexing instead)
Exporter outage recovery and runtime configuration reload
